import { createConfig } from "./oxfmt.strict.mts";

const shared = createConfig();
const importOrder = shared.sortImports as Exclude<
  typeof shared.sortImports,
  boolean | undefined
>;
const groups = importOrder.groups ?? [];

// Preserve existing runtime import evaluation order while retaining shared sorting.
export default createConfig({
  overrides: [
    {
      files: ["packages/dashboard/src/app/layout.tsx"],
      options: {
        sortImports: {
          ...importOrder,
          groups: [...groups.slice(1), groups[0]],
        },
      },
    },
    {
      files: ["packages/dashboard/src/components/ui/badge.tsx"],
      options: {
        sortImports: {
          ...importOrder,
          customGroups: [
            { groupName: "react-runtime", elementNamePattern: ["react"] },
          ],
          groups: ["react-runtime", ...groups],
        },
      },
    },
  ],
});
